hero.html:
Level 3 - Intermediate 55 min System Design Security

Security & Identity in System Design

After this page you can explain who a request is (authentication), what it may do (authorization), how tokens, OAuth 2.0, OIDC and SSO really flow, how data is protected on the wire and on disk, where secrets live, and how a design survives API abuse and DDoS, at the depth an SDE-1/2 interview expects.
